SwCluCProxyEcucPartitionRef OR  SwCluCDcmProxyRoutineControl . SwCluCProxyEcucPartitionRef OR  SwCluCDcmProxyServiceRequestNotification . SwCluCProxyE- cucPartitionRef OR • if a SwCluCDcmProxyBaseSocket is directly available, at its EcucPartition OR • at the EcucPartition of the SwCluCDcmProxyBaseSocket , referenced by the SwCluCDcmProxyBaseSocket - via SwCluCDcmProxyUsedSatel- liteRef , applicable for the EcucPartition requested above.
